planet.name: Calypso
planet.summary: Calypso is MindArk's main planet. New avatars arrive here after the Setesh starter moon (see the Setesh file). Newcomers work out of Port Atlantis and Camp Icarus, with a new mission chain from Nov 2026 and Daily Mission Terminal token dailies. Crystal Palace Space Station and Asteroid F.O.M.A. are optional orbital side trips.
planet.howToReach: New avatars take the onboarding transport from Setesh after its starter chain. Others use a token teleport (6 Teleportation Tokens station-to-station, 10 planet-to-planet on eligible links since 19.2.0), a player-run scheduled warp, or their own ship with a thruster.
warnings: Desk-checked from public sources only; in-game field verification is pending.

19.0.0 (Sep 2025) temporarily disabled the Calypso Gauntlet and moved the Vivo S10 reward to Setesh (Recon In The Jungle; its starting TT value was lowered to 2 PED in 19.10.1). A later Gauntlet reactivation is unverified. 19.2.0 rebuilt Port Atlantis, Camp Icarus and nearby beginner content, so older guides may be wrong.
Some Setesh starter rewards are excluded for avatars that completed Thule. Check each reward before using any skip option.
Daily Terminal bonus rolls, merchant inventory and timers come from player reports. Note acceptance, completion and hand-in times yourself.
Space routes can cross lootable PvP zones. Leave valuable cargo in storage.

activities.title: Move between Setesh and Calypso
activities.summary: New avatars start on Moon Setesh and use the onboarding transport to reach Calypso. Returning players have reported a pilot in Port Atlantis who flies to Setesh, and an exit terminal on Setesh for the way back. Repeat trips are not guaranteed, so check before moving gear.
steps: New avatar: finish the Setesh starter chain (see the Setesh file) and accept the onboarding transport to Calypso when it is offered.

Going back to Setesh from Calypso: players report a pilot down the stairs from the Port Atlantis teleporter, just past the service center on your right. Another reported route is to scroll the Calypso Space Station teleporter list to Setesh.
Leaving Setesh again: players report the skip terminal in the service building opposite the Cabrakan teleporter offers an exit after the tutorial.
Setesh storage is separate from Calypso storage. Empty it, and confirm your way back, before storing gear or taking a return shuttle.
rewards: Access to Calypso (or back to Setesh for unfinished starter rewards)
requirementsText: New avatars: the one-way trip to Calypso is offered once the Setesh main chain is done (see 'Leave Setesh for Calypso' in the Setesh file).

Existing avatars going to Setesh by the Camp Icarus VTOL: Mentor skill 2+ or highest combat profession 5 or lower (MindArk staff, Sep 2025). The Port Atlantis pilot and the space-station route have no published requirement.
Return trips to Setesh are player-reported, see warnings

prereqInfo.note: MindArk staff named the only official requirement: the Camp Icarus VTOL to Setesh needs Mentor skill 2+ or a highest combat profession of 5 or lower; otherwise fly to Setesh Space Station. Players report that new avatars get the trip to Calypso after the Setesh chain and that a skip terminal in Port Cabrakan lets you leave on later visits.
unknowns: Whether the Port Atlantis pilot has any requirement.
Whether the Port Cabrakan skip terminal needs anything (one player says to finish all missions first; another used it on a return visit).
Whether the onboarding trip can be taken before the Setesh chain is finished.

cost.text: No cost reported for the onboarding transport or the pilot.

locations.label: Port Atlantis pilot: down the stairs from the TP, past the service center on the right (a player posted a waypoint in March 2026; not copied in the research)
Setesh skip/exit terminal, service building opposite the Cabrakan TP (player report)

score.rationale: Every new avatar needs this step to reach Calypso. Free, but repeat-trip access is unreliable.

warnings: On a return visit, players reported the departure NPC no longer offered the trip. Verify repeat-trip access before relying on it.
Setesh starter missions, rewards and Small Iron are covered in the Setesh file; this entry only covers the transfer.
The exit offered by the skip terminal is a player report, not confirmed by MindArk. The waypoint is copied exactly as a player posted it (Dec 2025).

activities.title: Travel to other planets from Calypso
activities.summary: You do not need your own ship to change planets. A shared scheduled warp or a token teleport works. Since 19.2.0 the published token fare is 6 Teleportation Tokens between stations and 10 between planets on eligible links.
steps: Compare options: a player-run scheduled warp (Kronan posts Calypso/Arkadia legs and boarding points), a token teleport, or your own ship's fuel and decay.
For a token teleport, check the fare shown in the actual teleporter list. Moon routes may differ.
Token teleports have a 150 kg cap. Teleporting from a space station down to its own planet has no fee since 18.9.
Flying yourself needs a ship fitted with a thruster. Leave cargo in storage if the route crosses lootable PvP space. Non-lootable PvP zones and safe zones also exist.
rewards: Access to other planets and space stations
requirementsText: Token teleport: be at a space station teleporter with enough Teleportation Tokens (6 station-to-station, 10 planet-to-planet) and carry 150 kg or less.
Flying yourself: a space-capable vehicle with a Space Thruster equipped; 'Launch to Space' only works outside PvP areas.
Shared warp: a seat bought from the operator; its fare and rules are set by the operator.

prereqInfo.note: MindArk's 18.9.0 and 19.2.0 notes set the requirements: Teleportation Tokens (now 6 or 10) and a 150 kg limit for token teleports, a Space Thruster for flying yourself. Teleportation Tokens are craftable and tradable. No mission or skill is required by any source.

cost.text: 6 Teleportation Tokens station-to-station or 10 planet-to-planet (19.2.0, eligible links); shared warp fare set by the operator; or own ship fuel and decay.

currencies.name: Teleportation Token
currencies.note: 6 per station-to-station or 10 per planet-to-planet jump on eligible links.

score.rationale: Needed to leave the Calypso system; token fares are cheap, and no ship purchase is required.

warnings: Check the live fare in the teleporter list, especially for moons. Moon and orbit-to-surface connections are not separately verified.
Lootable PvP zones in space can cost you cargo. Shared-warp fares and cargo rules are set by the operator.
unknowns: Whether every moon and station link charges the same token fare.
